item.title: Limited-Time Po’Boy Pop-Ups Hit Houston this Month for Bayou City Po-Boys on Parade
item.description: Houston’s chefs are putting their own spin on one of the South’s most beloved sandwiches this month as Bayou City Po-Boys on Parade presented by Blue Plate Mayo returns for another round of limited-time pop-ups across the city. The multi-restaurant series brings together six standout Houston restaurants—Blood Bros.
